pages.title: Wordloft: Balloon Crossword
pages.creator: JCube asbl
pages.description: Pop balloons to fill the crossword in Wordloft: Balloon Crossword. Each balloon carries a letter, and choosing the right one sends it into the grid. Solve 100 mini crosswords across ten themes as you travel by hot-air balloon. Spend stars on Wind to clear incorrect choices whenever you need help. You can work through each grid at your own pace.

pages.title: Sea Battle Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Command a fleet against another player in Sea Battle Multi player. Join a lobby, choose where to aim, and take turns attacking and watching the results. You can hit the opposing fleet with torpedoes, triple bombs, or air strikes. Look for treasures to earn rewards and use the shop to pick up more items for your battles.

pages.title: Unite Words
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find what four words have in common in Unite Words. Swap words between rows until each row contains a complete set. On some boards, solving a special group reveals new words that you still have to sort. Watch the timer and use a hint to highlight a group if you get stuck.

pages.title: Slicer Duo
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Flip a knife through a course of fruit and other objects in Slicer Duo. Cut through the targets to earn points and time your flips so the blade clears hazards. The first player flips with Up Arrow and the second uses W, giving each knife its own key.

pages.title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Carry your momentum through the parkour courses in Bunnyhop and Surf Maps. Chain jumps and glide along sloped surfaces using movement inspired by Counter-Strike. You can build speed with a knife, change its appearance with skins, or race other players to see who can make it through a map first.

pages.title: Build an Aquapark
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description: Buy water slide sections and put them together in Build an Aquapark. Hop onto an inflatable ring to test the route you've built. Change the layout or pick up new sections to extend the slide, then take another ride to see how fast you can get.

pages.title: Football Duel
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play both sides of a 3D penalty shootout in Football Duel. Swipe when it's your turn to send a shot at the net, then switch to goalkeeping and swipe to make a save. The first player to score five goals wins, so a save can matter as much as a well-placed kick.

pages.title: Coffee Match Rush: Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Sort coffee cups into their trays in Coffee Match Rush: Sort Puzzle. Move the trays around the board to get the cups where they belong. Each level gives you a different layout to untangle before the timer expires, so check what a move opens up for the cups still on the board.

pages.title: My Tiny Market
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Run a supermarket from the stockroom to the checkout in My Tiny Market. Pick tomatoes, feed chickens, restock shelves, and ring up shoppers. Once you have more work than you can comfortably handle yourself, hire employees to help keep the store running as it grows.

pages.title: Merge Haven
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Help Liza restore a café in Merge Haven. Combine two matching items on the board to make something new and fill the orders you receive. Completing orders opens up more of the renovation and reveals pieces of the family's history as the café takes shape.

pages.title: Merry Christmas Connect
pages.creator: Puppy Yolk Studio
pages.description: Look for two tiles with the same picture in Merry Christmas Connect. Select matching tiles to remove them from the layout, then look for the next connection. Each level is complete when you've cleared the board, so keep scanning the remaining pictures as the number of tiles gets smaller.

pages.title: Obby: Gym Simulator, Escape
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Train Obby until he has the strength to escape the castle. Choose between barbells, dumbbells, and carrying weights, then take on bosses and work your way up the rankings. Spend cups on eggs to collect pets. They help you train faster as you prepare for the next challenge.

pages.title: Ragdoll Bob Puzzle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Build a route for Bob in this 2D physics puzzle. Place blocks and other objects to guide his floppy body toward the endpoint. You have a limited supply of pieces, so decide where each one will do the most good and see how many stars Bob can pick up along the way.

pages.title: Sticker Puzzle Book
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Work through the illustrated pages of Sticker Puzzle Book by finding where the pieces of each image belong. Use the details in the picture to guide your placements, then watch the scene take shape as you fit the stickers into it. Each page gives you a new illustration to work out.

pages.title: Real Drive 3D
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Start behind the wheel of an SUV in Real Drive 3D and learn to handle it through the opening courses. Work through the driving levels to unlock more vehicles and try them in different environments. Each new course gives you another chance to get comfortable with the vehicle you're driving.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear the layout in Solitaire Mahjong by pairing identical tiles. A tile is available when nothing covers it and at least one side is open. Look for matches that uncover more of the board, or use a hint if you get stuck. There's no timer, so you can compare moves before picking a pair.

pages.title: Cat Evolution
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Combine matching cats in Cat Evolution to discover what they turn into. Start with ordinary kittens, then keep merging to reveal new breeds and stranger hybrids. Every new discovery gives you another kind of cat to work with as you build up your collection and look for the next evolution.

pages.title: Fairy Wingerella
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Fly through each stage as Wingerella, a fairy setting out to grow more powerful. Steer around obstacles and collect power-ups to strengthen her magic as she travels. Use the keyboard or touch controls to guide her flight through the different challenges.

pages.title: Merge TikTok Gravity Knife
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Combine weapons in Merge TikTok Gravity Knife and try to raise your score before the clock runs out. If unmerged weapons get in the way, you can clear some of them with a special shot. You get one shot for free, so save it for a point when you need the extra space.

pages.title: Crazy Bunnies
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Rotate, jump, and grab your way through block-built platform levels in Crazy Bunnies. Play on your own or bring a partner into cooperative mode. Each bunny has its own controls, so you can move independently as you work through the Minecraft-inspired courses.

pages.title: iColorcoin Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: Funnyplus
pages.description: Sort chips by color in iColorcoin Sort Puzzle. Bring matching chips together and fill the grid so they can merge into a larger number. Plan where each chip will go before using up your available spaces. A good arrangement leaves you room to keep sorting as the numbers grow.

pages.title: Bomb Evolution
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Set up three bases and a rocket on a fog-covered island in Bomb Evolution. Then aim your artillery at an opponent who has the same setup on a neighboring island. Decide where to place your defenses and which base to target first. Destroy every enemy base to win the battle.

pages.title: Hydro Racing 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race speedboats through water courses in Hydro Racing 3D. Use nitrous when you need a burst of speed, work through the career chapters, or explore the map in free drive. You can take the controls alone or play with a second driver when you want someone on the water with you.

pages.title: Crowd Battle Gun Rush
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Start with an axe and collect bundles of cash as you run in Crowd Battle Gun Rush. Use the money to get stronger weapons and ammunition. The gear you pick up along the way determines what you have to fire at the crowds that are still standing when you reach the fight.

pages.title: Santa Run
pages.creator: GM Media
pages.description: Chase the raccoon that stole Santa's gold in Santa Run. Follow the thief through snowy landscapes as Santa, staying on the move while you work your way through the winter courses. The chase takes you away from the Christmas preparations and sends you after the missing gold.

pages.title: Number Line Match
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Find identical numbers or pairs that add up to ten in Number Line Match. Look across, down, and diagonally for connections. Clearing every number in a row removes that row, and running out of moves adds a new one. Keep the top row clear before another row arrives or the game ends.

pages.title: Football Kickoff
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Line up field goals in Football Kickoff. Watch the wind before choosing the angle and power of each kick, then send the ball between the uprights to score. Pay attention to how far off your last kick went and adjust the next one as you work your way up the scoreboard.

pages.title: Spooky Sort It
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sort spooky balls into tubes in Spooky Sort It. Move the balls around until each group is together in the right tube. Look for a tube that can hold a ball temporarily while you uncover the one below it, and work through the puzzle without running out of useful space.

pages.title: Steve Hardcore
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Gather every piece of obsidian in Steve Hardcore while steering clear of the green monsters. Once the black hole opens, go through it and find the portal inside the cave. You have three chances to die across the run, so a mistake can cost you progress beyond the stage you're playing.

pages.title: Count Alphabets Rush
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather letters as you run in Count Alphabets Rush. The letters you pick up become your allies and help you push back opposing letters. Choose a path that brings more of them to your side before you hit an enemy group, then send your team into the fight.

pages.title: Society FPS
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Defend a neighborhood from waves of attackers in Society FPS. Fight from a first-person view and watch for more enemies as each wave moves in. The attackers are trying to force the release of their leader, and your assignment is to clear every wave and secure the area.

pages.title: Alien Bubbles
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Move the bow to line up a shot in Alien Bubbles, then choose an arrow that matches the color of the alien you're targeting. Change arrow colors with V or switch arrow types with C. Special arrows hit harder, so save the limited supply for targets that need the extra damage.

pages.title: Fruit Matcher
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap neighboring fruits to line up at least three of a kind in Fruit Matcher. Matches can run across a row or down a column. Look for moves that clear the tiles you still need for the level, and use power-ups when you want to speed up the clear.

pages.title: Battboy Adventure 2
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Grapple onto platforms and throw a boomerang at enemies in Battboy Adventure 2. Guide Battboy through eight stages, using his gear to get past the obstacles in each one. If you want an extra challenge, look for all three stars in every level as you make your way through.

pages.title: Zombie Idle Defense 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fire at the zombies approaching your position in Zombie Idle Defense 3D. Tap the firing machine to send bullets at the enemies in front of it. Keep watching the approaching zombies so you know when to fire again and can hold the line as the next targets come into range.

pages.title: Idle Pizza Empire
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Grow a pizza restaurant in Idle Pizza Empire by putting its earnings back into the business. Upgrade the operation to make more money, then hire managers to automate parts of the workflow. As productivity grows, decide where to invest the extra income to keep expanding the restaurant.

pages.title: Word Search Relaxing Puzzles
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Trace hidden words through a letter grid in Word Search Relaxing Puzzles. Look along rows and columns, and check the reverse direction when a word is hard to spot. A hint can reveal one letter. Try to find the full list quickly if you're aiming for a place on the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Paper Flight
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Keep a paper plane in the air in Paper Flight. Press and hold to gain height, then let go to descend when you need to pass below an obstacle. A short lift or a longer glide can make the difference between clipping an obstacle and carrying on to a higher score.

pages.title: Racing Horizon
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Weave through highway traffic in Racing Horizon, a 3D driving game with several sports cars to try. Work through the racing career, take a car out on the endless road, or try a police chase mission. Upgrade your car as you go and see how it handles on different highway routes.

pages.title: Merge Race 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pick animal abilities that suit the terrain in Merge Race 3D. Take to the air with an eagle's flight, use a swimmer's abilities for water, or choose a runner for a long stretch of ground. Check what lies ahead before choosing the next skill so you can keep moving through the course.

pages.title: Truck Driver: Snowy Roads
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drive off-road trucks through snowy terrain in Truck Driver: Snowy Roads. Complete missions or compete in races to unlock more of the twelve trucks, each with its own handling and power. Take one out in Free Drive when you want to explore, where you may also encounter jobs that pay coins.

pages.title: Toys Math
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Buy toys by connecting numbers that add up to each price in Toys Math. Look for different combinations when the obvious numbers are unavailable. Get all eight toys before the level timer runs out, then see if you can finish the full set of twelve timed shopping challenges.

pages.title: Handstand Run
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Race on your hands in Handstand Run. Adjust your body tilt as you go over obstacles, and correct your balance before you tip too far. The aim is to finish first, so keep an eye on the next section of the course while you're getting over the current one.

pages.title: Swipe Runner
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Pick your ride on the move in Swipe Runner. Swipe right to take a vehicle or item and left to pass it up. Judge what will help on the course as the choices appear, and try to get ahead of your opponent by making the right call in time.

pages.title: Animals Party
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Get your monster through each round of Animals Party without being knocked out. Run against the other contestants and react as traps appear on the course. Pay attention to the route as well as the runners around you, since making it past the hazards is what keeps you in the competition.

pages.title: Real Shooting Fps Strike
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Play as a commando in Real Shooting Fps Strike, a 3D first-person shooter. Move around each map and clear out every enemy to advance to the next mission. Crouch or use your scope when the fight calls for it, then spend the money you earn on new guns and upgrades.

pages.title: Merge Animals 2
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Bring identical farm animals together in Merge Animals 2 to create a larger animal and earn points. Leave room for future matches as the board fills. If the animals get too close to the red line, use a bomb to make space and give yourself room to keep merging.

pages.title: Drag Racing 3D
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Race a computer-controlled driver in Drag Racing 3D. Build speed at the start, then watch for the moment to shift with E or Q. Shifting too early or too late can cost you ground. Press N for nitro when you want a burst of speed.

pages.title: Unicorn Chef Design Cake
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Make a mermaid cake in Unicorn Chef Design Cake. Work with bowls, mixers, molds, and an oven as you prepare the dessert, then switch to tools such as piping bags to decorate it. Choose from ingredients and toppings such as fruit, chocolate, candy, and sprinkles to finish your design.

pages.title: Space Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Get as many crewmates as you can to the goal in Space Rush. Keep the group moving across platforms, time jumps near the edges, and watch for bombs or objects that block the route. Every crewmate that makes it to the finish helps you meet the aim of the level.

pages.title: Type Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Type the sentence on screen to move your runner in Type Run. Faster typing makes your character run faster, and your opponents get tougher as you progress. Work through each new line quickly and try to maintain your pace long enough to stay ahead across several levels.

pages.title: Grand Commander
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Fight off zombies on the ground and in the air as the ranger in Grand Commander. Fire your shotgun and use special attacks such as firestorms, lightning, or ice when you need extra firepower. Pick up coins and other items as you work your way past the enemies.

pages.title: Jump.io
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Clear obstacles before the other racers in Jump.io. Time each jump so you can get over what's in front of you and keep moving down the course. Pay attention to how far away the next obstacle is as you try to stay ahead in the race.

pages.title: Fun Gravity Ball
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Flip gravity to move the orange ball to the opposite side of the track in Fun Gravity Ball. Switch sides before you reach spikes or blocks, and pick up red crystals to add to your score. The ball moves quickly, so look ahead and see how far you can keep it rolling.

pages.title: Pet Doctor : Animal Care Game
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: Look after animal patients in Pet Doctor : Animal Care Game. Pick up the tool you need for each task, whether you're taking a temperature or putting on a bandage. Work through the treatments with the mouse and help the animals as they come through the hospital.

pages.title: Colores Square
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Keep the bouncing ball inside the square in Colores Square. Watch its color and the wall it's moving toward, then tap in time to prevent it from hitting a wall of the same color. Keep the run going and see if you can improve on your best score.

pages.title: Pop The Virus
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Tap as many cartoon viruses as you can before time runs out in Pop The Virus. Some targets pop quickly, while the ones wearing masks are harder to clear. Keep scanning for targets and decide when to spend more taps on a stubborn one as you try to raise your count.

pages.title: Yes Man Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Give the Yes-Man drawings your own colors in Yes Man Coloring. Pick a picture and a paint color, then use the mouse to work on the drawing. Change the brush size when you want to cover a larger area or work on a smaller detail.

pages.title: Ice Cream Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Study the ice cream order while the picture is on screen in Ice Cream Memory. It disappears after a few seconds, leaving you to rebuild the dessert from memory. Compare what you made with the original order. A mismatch sends your creation to the trash.

pages.title: Shot and Kill
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Make your shots count as you move through enemy encounters in Shot and Kill. Use the mouse to fire when you have a clear shot, and try to take down the gunmen before they can hit you. Keep an eye on the next enemy as you move through the stage.

pages.title: Fast Madness
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Find a path through busy traffic in Fast Madness. Watch the cars ahead as you look for fuel to extend your drive and shields to help you stay on the road. There are four tracks to try, and you can buy a different car when you want a change.

pages.title: Five Nations
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Manage a space fleet and the economy behind it in Five Nations. The real-time strategy battles run alongside decisions about what to construct and produce. Keep resources coming while you maneuver your forces, then decide whether your next investment should go toward the economy or toward the ships you need in combat.

pages.title: Stunt Racers Extreme
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Pick a supercar and take it out on the track in Stunt Racers Extreme. Customize the car you're driving and earn stars for your performance. You can spend the stars to unlock other cars, giving you something to work toward each time you head back out for a run.

pages.title: Crazy Sniper Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pick a weapon and armor before facing the enemy in Crazy Sniper Shooter. Take aim as more opponents arrive and work through the encounter with the gear you've chosen. Pay attention to the incoming targets so you can line up shots while the fight is still in your favor.

pages.title: Mission in Space Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare two space-themed pictures and mark what has changed in Mission in Space Difference. Each pair contains seven differences and gives you one minute to find them. Scan the matching parts of the pictures for small details that are missing or altered, then move on through the ten levels.

pages.title: Crush to Party: Halloween Edition
pages.creator: Firstpixel
pages.description: Play quick monster challenges to furnish a Halloween party in Crush to Party: Halloween Edition. Some rounds ask you to smash monster heads, while others ask you to match them. Score points in the rounds and spend them on decorations to build up the party scene.

pages.title: FZ Happy Halloween
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Turn over Halloween cards and look for identical pictures in FZ Happy Halloween. Remember where you've seen each image so you can pair it when its match appears. Clear all the pairs before the clock runs down, then see how you fare as the layouts get tougher over eighteen levels.

pages.title: 4 in Row Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drop colored pieces into a standing grid in 4 in Row Mania. Take turns with a friend or set a difficulty and face the computer. Connect four of your color across, down, or diagonally before your opponent does. Watch their lines as well as your own when you choose a column.

pages.title: Chicken Shooter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Hunt infected chickens across several levels in Chicken Shooter. Move the mouse to bring a chicken into your sights, then use the left mouse button to fire. Right-click to aim more closely when you need a steadier view of a target.

pages.title: Maggie Bread Rush
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Check each customer's order in Maggie Bread Rush and click the right bread to put it on a plate. If you pick the wrong bread, discard it before serving. Unfinished orders cost experience as time passes, so keep plates moving through all eight stages as the service gets busier.

pages.title: BTS Fun Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a picture to color in BTS Fun Coloring. The options include cars, a bike, drums, and a rocket. Pick colors for the different parts of your drawing, or try a different picture when you want to work with a new set of shapes.

pages.title: Run Race 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Time your jumps to stay ahead in Run Race 3D. Tap as you approach a jump and watch where your racer will land before making the next move. The other racers keep going, so get through the course cleanly if you want to reach the finish first.

pages.title: The Walls
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Steer a rolling ball through gaps in approaching walls in The Walls. Spot the opening early and line up with it before the next wall reaches you. Collect coins along the way to unlock different wall styles as you try to keep the run going.

pages.title: Anna Preparing for Christmas
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help Anna get ready to decorate her Christmas tree. Pick clothes that will keep her warm outside, then turn your attention to the tree. Choose how to decorate it after you've settled on her outfit, giving Anna and her tree their own looks for the holiday.

pages.title: Mens Fashion
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Put together men's outfits for nine occasions in Mens Fashion. Choose what suits a day at school or the office, then switch to looks for a date, a movie night, or a pool party. Each occasion gives you a different reason to rethink the clothing combination.

pages.title: Cartoon Motorbike Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pick a motorbike picture and piece it back together in Cartoon Motorbike Jigsaw. There are twelve illustrations to choose from. Play with 25 pieces for a smaller puzzle, 49 for a middle-sized one, or 100 if you want more shapes and details to sort through.

pages.title: YORG.io
pages.creator: Tobias Springer IT Solutions
pages.description: Build a base that can last through zombie attacks in YORG.io. Set up mines and processors to supply your defenses, then place towers to keep the zombies out after dark. Think about the route resources take to reach your towers as you expand and try to survive another night.

pages.title: Crossword Scapes
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Drag across the available letters to spell words in Crossword Scapes. When you find a word the puzzle is looking for, it appears in the grid. Use the words you've already placed to work out what's missing, or ask for a hint when a gap has you stuck.

pages.title: Monster Cafe
pages.creator: Bit Egg Inc
pages.description: Feed monsters and ghosts by matching bubbles in Monster Cafe. Aim at groups of the same color to turn the matched bubbles into food for your customers. Keep making matches as the bubbles come in and see how long you can keep serving while you build up your score.

pages.title: Paris Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Look for hidden stars in five pictures of Paris in Paris Hidden Stars. Scan each image for small star shapes that blend in with the scene. Once you've found the stars in one picture, move on to the next and see whether you can spot them all.

pages.title: Autumn Must Haves for Princesses
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Shop for fall clothes with Elsa and Jasmine in Autumn Must Haves for Princesses. Try combinations drawn from the game's seasonal trends, including military jackets, midi skirts, vintage furs, and seventies plaid. Put together an outfit for each princess using the pieces you find during the shopping trip.

pages.title: BFFs College Dorm
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help two friends clean and redecorate their room in BFFs College Dorm. Pick up loose clothes and trash, wipe away the dust, and wash the windows. Once the room is tidy, choose furniture and decorations to give the friends a space they can make their own.

pages.title: Fashion Princesses And Balloon Festival
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style the princesses for an outing in Fashion Princesses And Balloon Festival. Pick what each one will wear, then choose a hairstyle and add jewelry or other accessories to finish the outfit. You can give each princess a different look as they get ready for the festival.

pages.title: Ice Cream Sandwich Cake
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Shop for recipe ingredients and turn them into a dessert in Ice Cream Sandwich Cake. Follow the steps to prepare the cake, then decide how to present it. Choose the finishing decorations once the cooking is done and give the ice cream sandwich cake your own look.

pages.title: Draculaura's Blind Date
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Take a short quiz to help Draculaura choose between Clawd Wolf and Garrott du Roque in Draculaura's Blind Date. Once the quiz reveals her match, get her dressed for the outing. Try dresses or two-piece outfits and finish the look with heels and jewelry from her wardrobe.

pages.title: Princesses Closet
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Open the wardrobe and get two princesses ready for a party in Princesses Closet. Try different outfits on each princess and see which look suits her for the evening. Work through the clothing choices until both have something to wear to the party.
